meta.title: Rethink Lead Generation: Advanced Strategies to Generate More Leads for Your Business
meta.author: Tom Shapiro

sentences: Discover how **Tom Shapiro** encourages marketers to rethink **lead generation** strategies with **creativity** and **lateral thinking**.

Through insights such as **SAP's** innovative content approach and trailblazing examples from **Larry Kim** and **Salesforce**, readers learn to challenge norms and go beyond best practices to drive substantial growth.
Essentially, this book empowers businesses to achieve remarkable results by prioritizing creative approaches instead of traditional methods.

parts.title: Free Offers Boost SEO and Leads

sentences: Understanding **Page Load Testing** can be crucial for businesses.
**Pingdom** offers a **free tool** for you to **test web page load times** from different global server locations.
Why free?
It's **SEO strategy** genius: **34,000 websites** link back to Pingdom.
Similarly, **Tableau exploded** in traffic using **a free version** of their software, which attracted many non-expert users.
This **free strategy** was an entry point for **future upgrades** to paid products.
**Nearly 100,000 websites** gave them **9 million links**, highlighting how free tools can lead to **SEO benefits**.

parts.title: Effective VoC Collection with Contextual Surveys

sentences: Stratabeat generates valuable VoC (Voice of Customer) by using **contextual surveys** on relevant blog post topics like SEO or behavioral intelligence.
This method ensures **high-quality** audience feedback and insights into industry challenges.
**Qualitative** responses, especially the final questions, offer unique insights competitors may not have.
Conducting **annual surveys** establishes authority in industries, as ongoing reports maintain audience interest and media attention.
They prove vital in capturing leads, as seen with companies like **Provenir** and platforms like **Drift** that effectively use **surveys** and **chatbots** to qualify leads and guide conversations.

parts.title: Harnessing Personalization on Your Website for Better Engagement

paragraphs.heading: Personalization Strategies
sentences: Personalizing your website can massively boost lead generation by **tailoring experiences** to visitor segments.

Using tools such as **marketing automation** and **IP detection software**, you can customize messaging, imagery, and calls-to-action (CTAs) based on the visitor's **geolocation** or **expressed interests**.
For instance, you can refine pages in your account-based marketing (ABM) campaigns to ensure they meet the **specific needs** of your target companies.
Tools like interactive **wizards** or **surveys** can further customize experiences by capturing visitor details, enhancing segmentation and personalization.

paragraphs.heading: Efficient Personalization Techniques
sentences: Even without advanced tools, basic personalization in your website—targeting **different industries** or **job roles**—can elevate user experience and conversion rates.
This results in a more satisfying engagement, leading to an increase in on-site time and better interaction.
It not only forms a **personal connection** with visitors but can significantly **boost site performance**.
Continual refinement and A/B testing of personalized elements will continuously enhance outcomes and optimize user journeys.
For effective **content marketing**, aim to create work that **captures your audience's attention**.
Think **creatively** and use content as a way to **build relationships** rather than solely for gaining search visibility and traffic.
Use **original, captivating campaigns** like Wistia's "Video Marketing Week" to draw in audience engagement.

This campaign shows that creating a unique event or experience can be a powerful strategy to attract and retain audience interest, ultimately generating leads and providing **valuable educational content**.

parts.title: Create Bigger Impact with Content & Master Google E-A-T

sentences: **Create Bigger Impact with Content**
Content **helps** potential customers decide to **buy** from you.
Use specific tools like **case studies** and **ROI calculators**.
Even if **search volume** is low, it moves buyers **closer** to purchasing.
General content doesn't work well at the **bottom** of the funnel.
Think **precision** and **specificity**.
For web design services, for instance, narrow down to specific topics like "**increase the conversion rates** of a software website."
**Master Google E-A-T for Success**
No matter where your content fits (top, middle, or bottom), consider Google **E-A-T** (Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness).
Many marketers don't know this, which needs to change.
It's **vital** for **SEO** and protects your content from getting **disqualified** by Google.
Enhance your content with **proof** of expertise.
Especially critical for **health** or **wealth** subjects, known as **YMYL** (Your Money Your Life) topics.
**ABM** is a powerful strategy for growing both new and existing accounts.
For example, **Pegasystems** successfully expanded **JPMorgan Chase** by using **ABM techniques** like internal webinars and account-specific **LinkedIn groups**.
They even had **JPMorgan employees** promote **Pegasystems** solutions, boosting **conversion rates** and **ROI** by leveraging personal **endorsements** within the company.
ABM helps **understand accounts holistically**, offering scalable opportunities for deep **engagement**.
